description: This file implements Windows registry key management functions, including creating, opening, closing, deleting, and enumerating registry keys and values. It defines classes RegKey, RegistryValueIterator, and RegistryKeyIterator for interacting with the Windows registry in C++.

classes.name: RegKey
classes.description: A class encapsulating Windows registry key operations such as create, open, close, delete, and enumerate values and subkeys.

classes.name: RegistryValueIterator
classes.description: An iterator class for enumerating registry values within a specific registry key.

classes.name: RegistryKeyIterator
classes.description: An iterator class for enumerating subkeys within a specific registry key.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a registry key under a specified root key with given access rights.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the currently opened registry key.

methods.name: DeleteKey
methods.description: Deletes a subkey, with recursive deletion if necessary.

methods.name: DeleteEmptyKey
methods.description: Deletes a subkey only if it is empty.

methods.name: ReadValueDW
methods.description: Reads a DWORD value from the registry.

methods.name: ReadInt64
methods.description: Reads a 64-bit integer value from the registry.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Reads a string or binary value from the registry.
